title: A bad import path in a _test.go file reports as 'no required module provides package' at the import, not as the typo it is
body: During this tick a one-character module typo (peterengelbrecht for pengelbrecht) in two test files made `go test`/`go vet` report 'no required module provides package github.com/peterengelbrecht/ticfac/internal/…' against the import line of files that also had unrelated bodies, with identical-import probes passing or failing apparently at random across cache states. It cost roughly 45 minutes of bisection against a toolchain that attributes the error to an import rather than to the package name it cannot find. Worth an upstream report (golang/go) or, if the Go issue already exists, a line in this repo's learnings so the next worker greps the module name first.
